name: transition-block-cover
title: Staggered Blocks
description: Lưới ô màu bật lên theo đường chéo phủ kín khung, đổi cảnh, rồi các ô thu lại theo cùng thứ tự.

moworks.author: moworks

options.duration: s (0.8: cover, cut at the middle, clear)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: 8 x 5 grid of solid accent tiles (each 1/8 x 1/5 of the frame, 1 px overlap). Cover 0-400 ms: tile (col i, row j) starts (i + j) x 10 ms (demo; the recipe says '30 ms stagger'), scale 0 -> 1 about its centre over 250 ms easeOutCubic, frame covered by 360 ms; cut at 400 ms; clear 400-800 ms in the same diagonal order, scale 1 -> 0 easeInCubic. Params: grid (8 × 5) · stagger chéo (10 ms) · duration mỗi ô (0.25 s) · color.
moworks.titleVi: Ô vuông phủ kín rồi rút
